articles.summary: Ticker symbol to remain “RHLD” NEW YORK, Sept. 08, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Resolute Holdings Management, Inc. (Nasdaq: RHLD) (“Resolute Holdings” or the “Company”) today announced that it will transfer the listing of its common stock to the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) from the Nasdaq Stock Market (“Nasdaq”).
